scope: Six fixed development VAL windows: one per dataset/mode; clean/noisy each. Three windows per macro mean. Not full validation or TEST; input simulator uses naturally visible GT-derived positions with optional smooth noise.

interpretation.EXO: All clean windows improve world, hidden, visible, root and foot low-speed. Noisy world and hidden improve in 2/3 windows; TRUMANS noisy world/hidden worsens. Foot-motion RMS and stride errors improve all6 EXO regime-window pairs, not merely reducing motion amplitude to zero.
interpretation.EGO: All6 clean/noisy EGO world and hidden cases regress; foot low-speed worsens all6. Therefore 20 percent replay did not retain EGO behavior in this stage.
interpretation.retain_decision: Retain final as an EXO-specialized experimental candidate and keep41k parent for EGO. This stage does not pass the stated shared-model EGO-retention objective. No automatic promotion/extension; broader development VAL and severe occlusion tests remain needed.
interpretation.RICH_caution: EXO RICH window is largely stationary: GT bilateral motion RMS0.00948m; foot-motion ratio deliberately null. Very low EXO clean MPJPE is conditioned on simulator-derived highly visible joint positions and is not comparable to head-only EGO or RGB-only tracker methods.
